SS(8)                     System Manager's Manual                    SS(8)

NAME
       ss - fake socket statistics page for tests

OPTIONS
       -n, --numeric
              Show numbers, do not resolve service names.

       -l, --listening
              Show only listening sockets (these are left
              out by default).

       -t, --tcp
              Show TCP sockets.

       -u, --udp
              Show UDP sockets.

       -p, --processes
              Show the process using each socket.

USAGE EXAMPLES
       ss -t -a
              Text that mentions -l in passing, more indented.
              -l  in an example, deeper than the option list.
